fact: Fifteen feet of reach is a very generous number when the thing reaching lives on the floor and I have been hovering at the ceiling being useless.

fact: The swarm hit the cavern entrance like a wall of sound and motion — a biblical chittering that shredded the fungal minions instantly, all thirteen hit points of them, gone before they could do anything useful.
